p: famine was sore in the land: This was a great temptation to Jacob to suffer such a great famine in the land where God had promised to bless him.
double money in your hand: When we are in need or danger, God does not forbid us to use honest means to better our estate and condition.
God Almighty give you mercy before: Our main trust should be in God, not in worldly means.
bereaved of my children: He speaks these words not so much in despair, but to make his sons more careful to return with their brother.
afraid: So the judgment of God weighed on their consciences.
your God: Despite the corruption of Egypt, Joseph taught his family to fear God.
mother's son: For only these two were born of Rachel.
set on for him by himself: To signify his dignity.
abomination unto the Egyptians: The nature of the superstitions is to condemn all others in respect to themselves.
and were merry with him: Sometimes this word means "to be drunken", but here it means that they had enough, and drank of the best wine.
